entities.name: Teremko Mountains
entities.description: Mountain range once the boundary between Zhalfir and Femeref, now split between Zhalfir and Dominaria.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Plane holding the northern branch of the Teremkos.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Region on Dominaria with the southern branch.

entities.name: Zuberi
entities.description: Golden griffin said to live in Griffin Canyon.

entities.name: Vuel
entities.description: Failed his rite of passage and accepted Starke's offer of leadership of Rath.

entities.name: Starke
entities.description: Poisoned Vuel's body paint on Phyrexian orders and offered him leadership of Rath.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Phased a branch of the Teremkos out of Dominaria.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion during which Teferi phased out the mountains.

events.summary: Starke catches up with Vuel in the foothills and offers him leadership of Rath and vengeance; Vuel accepts.
events.quote: Starke offered Vuel a chance for both leadership of Rath and vengeance against his brother and father, which Vuel accepted.

events.summary: Teferi phases one branch of the Teremkos out of Dominaria during the Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: One branch of the Teremkos were phased out of Dominaria by Teferi

relations.quote: Starke having poisoned his body paint on the orders of his Phyrexian masters
